detailed_description: SVG Pattern Generator is a creative tool for designing seamless patterns for web backgrounds and graphics. Choose from various pattern types including geometric shapes, stripes, dots, waves, and more. Customize colors, sizes, spacing, and rotation to create unique designs. The tool generates optimized SVG code that's lightweight and scales perfectly at any resolution. Export your patterns as inline SVG, CSS background-image, or downloadable SVG files. Perfect for web designers, UI developers, and anyone needing custom background patterns.
